entries.note: The Shenzhen warehouse's receipt, SHENGAO's first scan, in the English the platform's other tenants give it.

entries.wording: Parcel received at Shenzhen Sorting Centre.
entries.note: The line's sorting centre, after the warehouse's receipt: the line taking the parcel on, not its acceptance.

entries.wording: Parcel processed at Shenzhen Sorting Centre.
entries.note: The line's sorting centre, its city in the wording.

entries.wording: Parcel departure in Shenzhen Sorting Centre.
entries.note: The line's sorting centre sending the parcel on.
The warehouse's departure, minutes after the line's sorting centre sent the parcel on.
China's export declaration, before the flight: the parcel is not held.

entries.wording: Parcel departure in Transit Facility, Parcel Departure
entries.note: The line-haul agent sending the parcel to the airport, after the export declaration.

entries.wording: Parcel is leaving Airport, Parcel Leaving Port
entries.note: The flight leaving the airport of origin.

entries.wording: Parcel is leaving Transit Airport, Parcel Leaving Port
entries.note: The connecting flight leaving the transit airport.

entries.wording: Parcel arrives at Airport, Parcel Arrival
entries.note: The flight's arrival at the destination airport.

entries.wording: Parcel arrives at Transit Airport, Parcel Arrival
entries.note: Written beside the destination airport's arrival, minutes after it: an arrival, not a hold.
The destination's import clearance done, the parcel goes on.
The last-mile partner's depot in the destination country taking the parcel in, after the import clearance.
The last-mile partner's record of the parcel's data, a second after its depot's receipt: the journey goes on.
The last-mile partner's round, after its depot took the parcel in again.
The last-mile partner's delivery, hours after the round.
